Plugin.Name: Asustor Control
Plugin.ExtraSearchTerms: asustor nas lcd led fan temperature hwmon lockerstor
Plugin.Overview:
Drives the front-panel LCD and the LEDs of an Asustor NAS that runs Unraid, and shows and logs what the fan, the CPU and the disks are doing.
- The LCD cycles through the screens you pick: hostname, IP address, temperatures, array status, time and uptime, fan. - Front-panel LEDs: per-bay disk activity and fault LEDs, and a status LED that follows the array. Locate blinks a bay's LED. - USB Copy button: a short and a long press can log, notify, locate or run your own script. - A hardware monitor with fan, CPU and drive temperatures, a fan history chart and a log of what the fan reacted to.
It needs the kernel drivers from the Asustor Platform Drivers plugin. Fan control stays with FanCtrl Plus: this plugin has no fan curve of its own.
